title: Reading widely, without a plan
detail: Philosophy, history and politics, read out of interest rather than toward anything. Most of the questions I work on now came from this period, badly formed.

title: Starting to write it down
detail: Writing turned out to be the only reliable way to find out whether I understood something. The Osho research document was the first attempt at that at real length.

title: Running into the data problem
detail: The terrorism visualisation project began as a plotting exercise and became a lesson in how much of research is deciding what a number is allowed to mean.

title: Building the tools instead of wanting them
detail: The worksheet generator design and this website are both attempts to stop treating software as something other people make.

title: Prototyping, and publishing properly
detail: Turning the worksheet generator design into something running, and putting the writing on this site instead of in private files.
